dialogue.origin: ロールプレイよろしくおねがいします、
dialogue.content: Thank you for joining me for this role-play session.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: きょうはどんな相談でしょうか？年代と性別をおねがいします。
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today? Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 17歳女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a 17-year-old female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。きょうはどんな事でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. So, what's on your mind today?

dialogue.origin: 彼とのことで悩んでします
dialogue.content: I'm worried about my relationship with my boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: 彼との事で何のお話しかな？
dialogue.content: What about your boyfriend would you like to talk about?

dialogue.origin: 彼がラインを返さないと怒る
dialogue.content: He gets angry if I don't reply to his LINE messages right away.

dialogue.origin: そうなのね怒られると気分悪いね
dialogue.content: I see. It must feel awful when he gets angry with you.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 彼は直ぐにかえさないと怒るタイプなのかな。
dialogue.content: Is he the type of person who gets angry if you don't reply right away?

dialogue.origin: 返さないのは最近なので、性格とは違うと思います
dialogue.content: This has only started recently, so I don't think it's part of his personality.

dialogue.origin: 他には彼はどんな性格だと感じています？
dialogue.content: How else would you describe his personality?

dialogue.origin: ホントは優しい人だけど、最近は、思い通りにならないと怒ってくることが多いです
dialogue.content: He's actually a kind person, but recently, he often gets angry when things don't go his way.

dialogue.origin: そう、怒ってばかりじゃ楽しくないね。普段は優しいんだね。どんな時優しかった？？
dialogue.content: I see, it can't be fun when he's always angry. You said he's usually kind. Can you tell me about a time when he was kind?

dialogue.origin: 気分のいい時はとてもやさしいです
dialogue.content: He's very kind when he's in a good mood.

dialogue.origin: 最近彼が高校を辞めて、
dialogue.content: Recently, he dropped out of high school, and...

dialogue.origin: そう、急に怒りだすのかな。悲しくなるね。
dialogue.content: I see. Does he get angry all of a sudden? That must be upsetting for you.

dialogue.origin: 学校やめて？それで
dialogue.content: He dropped out of school? And then what happened?

dialogue.origin: 言うことをきかないと怒ります
dialogue.content: He gets angry if I don't do what he says.

dialogue.origin: 彼は家にずっと言いて、
dialogue.content: He's been staying at home all the time,

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ずっと居て、
dialogue.content: staying there constantly,

dialogue.origin: ユーチューバーになるとか言っています
dialogue.content: and he says he's going to become a YouTuber.

dialogue.origin: そう、彼は夢を持っているんだあなたは彼の夢をどう思う？
dialogue.content: I see, so he has a dream. What do you think about his dream?

dialogue.origin: その前に働けばいいのにって思います
dialogue.content: I think he should get a job first.

dialogue.origin: そっか彼は仕事をさがしているのかな？
dialogue.content: I see. Is he looking for a job?

dialogue.origin: 探してないと思います
dialogue.content: I don't think he is.

dialogue.origin: あなたはがっかりだね。
dialogue.content: That must be disappointing for you.

dialogue.origin: 彼がどうなってくれると嬉しいかな？
dialogue.content: What change in him would make you happy?

dialogue.origin: それより、束縛されるのが嫌です
dialogue.content: More than that, I hate feeling controlled.

dialogue.origin: でも、私がなんとかしないと
dialogue.content: But I feel like I have to do something.

dialogue.origin: じゃあきゅうくつに感じるかな
dialogue.content: So you feel suffocated?

dialogue.origin: はい、窮屈です
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel suffocated.

dialogue.origin: なんとかしてあげたいね、きっと彼はあなたと居たいと思っているかも。
dialogue.content: You want to help him, don't you? He probably just wants to be with you.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれないけど、怖いです
dialogue.content: That might be true, but I'm scared.

dialogue.origin: 怖い？怒るとそんなに怖いの？
dialogue.content: Scared? Is he that scary when he gets angry?

dialogue.origin: どんな風に怖いの？
dialogue.content: In what way is he scary?

dialogue.origin: お金を貸してくれと言われて、
dialogue.content: He asks me to lend him money, and...

dialogue.origin: 最初は3000円とかくらいだったけど、
dialogue.content: At first it was about 3,000 yen...

dialogue.origin: 今は5000円くらい貸して　と言われて、
dialogue.content: But now he asks for about 5,000 yen,

dialogue.origin: でも返してくれない
dialogue.content: but he doesn't pay me back.

dialogue.origin: そう、お金は嫌だね。だんだん返してくれなくなった。
dialogue.content: I see, the money issue is difficult. He gradually stopped paying you back.

dialogue.origin: バイトした分とかで貸してきたけど、これからどうしようかと思って…
dialogue.content: I've been lending him money from my part-time job earnings, and I don't know what to do from now on...

dialogue.origin: そっか彼のためにバイトしていたんだ
dialogue.content: I see, so you were working your part-time job for him.

dialogue.origin: 自分のお小遣いのためにしてたんだけど、返してっていったんだけど、
dialogue.content: Well, I was doing it for my own spending money, and I asked him to pay me back, but...

dialogue.origin: そのうちでっかく稼いで返すとか言われて、
dialogue.content: He just says he'll pay me back when he makes it big.

dialogue.origin: 彼はあなたから借りたお金を何に使うか知っている？
dialogue.content: Do you know what he uses the money he borrows from you for?

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: でも彼を支えるのは自分しか居ないのかなと
dialogue.content: But I feel like I'm the only one who can support him.

dialogue.origin: 自分しかいないんだね。支える人は
dialogue.content: So you feel you're the only person who can support him.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、これ以上お金もないし、彼は怖いし、
dialogue.content: But I don't have any more money, and I'm scared of him,

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいかわかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、お金貸さないと怒りだすしね。
dialogue.content: I understand. And he gets angry if you don't lend him money.

dialogue.origin: それに、言うことをきかないと殴るんです。
dialogue.content: Also, he hits me if I don't do what he says.

dialogue.origin: 殴る？怪我は大丈夫？
dialogue.content: He hits you? Are you okay? Did you get hurt?

dialogue.origin: もう一月以上たったので、あざも治りました。大丈夫です
dialogue.content: It's been over a month, so the bruises have healed. I'm okay.

dialogue.origin: 大変な目にあったね。あなたのご両親は知っている？
dialogue.content: You went through something terrible. Do your parents know?

dialogue.origin: 誰にも話していません
dialogue.content: I haven't told anyone.

dialogue.origin: 話せないね。だれにも一人で抱えているんだね。
dialogue.content: It's hard to talk about, isn't it? You've been carrying this all by yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 彼は怪我のこと何か言いました？
dialogue.content: Did he say anything about your injuries?

dialogue.origin: 一緒に病院に行くなど、何かしてくれました？
dialogue.content: Did he do anything, like take you to the hospital?

dialogue.origin: 後で、ホントごめん、ごめん、って、とっても優しくしてくれました
dialogue.content: Afterwards, he was very gentle with me and kept saying, "I'm so sorry, I'm sorry."

dialogue.origin: そう、それであなたは許してあげようと思ったの？
dialogue.content: I see. And did that make you want to forgive him?

dialogue.origin: 彼は優しいところもあるから。
dialogue.content: Because he has a kind side, too.

dialogue.origin: 彼には私しかしないし
dialogue.content: And I'm the only one he has.

dialogue.origin: そっか、彼のこと好きだし、支えてあげたくなるんだ。
dialogue.content: I see. You like him, so you feel that you want to support him.

dialogue.origin: それに、きつくい言った私が悪いんだし
dialogue.content: Besides, it was my fault for speaking harshly to him.

dialogue.origin: だから、私がなんとかしなきゃと思います
dialogue.content: That's why I think I have to be the one to fix things.

dialogue.origin: ”きつく”なんてあなたは言ったのあなたが悪く感じるんだね。
dialogue.content: When you say you spoke "harshly," it sounds like you feel it's your fault.

dialogue.origin: だから、私が悪いんです
dialogue.content: That's why it's my fault.

dialogue.origin: そう、きつく言うことが悪いかな？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you think that speaking firmly is wrong?

dialogue.origin: 私が気に障る言い方をしたのは悪いと思います
dialogue.content: I think it was wrong of me to say things that would upset him.

dialogue.origin: 彼だって善悪はわかると思うけど。・・・
dialogue.content: But I think he knows the difference between right and wrong...

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。あなたもご両親にきつく言われることあるよね。
dialogue.content: I see. You sometimes get spoken to harshly by your parents too, right?

dialogue.origin: どんな時いわれる？
dialogue.content: When does that happen?

dialogue.origin: 何度も繰り返した時かな
dialogue.content: When I repeat the same mistake, I guess.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。彼はそれに気がついていないかも。
dialogue.content: Right. He might not have realized that.

dialogue.origin: ここで今までの話をまとめてみていいかな？
dialogue.content: Would it be okay if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたはバイトで稼いだお金を彼に貸しているが返ってこない、仕事はさがして様子もない。夢はユーチューバー時々なぐられたりするけどあなたは自分が支えてあげないとと感じているようですね。
dialogue.content: So, you're lending your boyfriend the money you earn from your part-time job, but he doesn't pay it back and shows no signs of looking for a job. His dream is to be a YouTuber. Sometimes he hits you, but you feel that you're the only one who can support him. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい、私しかいませんから
dialogue.content: Yes, because he only has me.

dialogue.origin: 彼もあなたも善悪の判断はできるかと思います。きつく言わねばならない時きちんと言ってもいいと思いますがどうでしょう？
dialogue.content: I believe both you and he can judge what's right and wrong. When you need to be firm, I think it's okay to state things clearly. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: はい。だから、彼も私にきつく言ってくるんですよね
dialogue.content: Yes. And that's why he speaks harshly to me too, right?

dialogue.origin: 言われた彼は急に優しくなるようですがそこでも毅然とした態度をとってもいいと思います。
dialogue.content: After what happened, he becomes very gentle, but I think it's okay for you to maintain a firm attitude even then.

dialogue.origin: それでもあらためないようでしたら距離を置いてみてはいかが？かなり厳しいかもしれませんが
dialogue.content: If he still doesn't change his ways, how about putting some distance between you? It might be very difficult, though.

dialogue.origin: このままだとあなたが傷つきます。
dialogue.content: If things continue this way, you will get hurt.

dialogue.origin: 彼も大事だけど、あなたも大事にしてください。未来のある方ですから。
dialogue.content: He is important, but you need to value yourself, too. You have a future ahead of you.

dialogue.origin: もし、納得しないようでしたらまた、ここにいつでも来てください。
dialogue.content: If you still don't feel settled, please feel free to come back here anytime.

dialogue.origin: 今はよくわかりません
dialogue.content: I don't really know right now.

dialogue.origin: そうだね。
dialogue.content: That's understandable.

dialogue.origin: 今、彼とのことよく考えてみてね。
dialogue.content: Take some time to think carefully about your situation with him.

dialogue.origin: はい、考えてみたいと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I'd like to think it over.

dialogue.origin: 好きな気持ちは大切に。
dialogue.content: Cherish your feelings of affection.

dialogue.origin: これでロールプレイを終了します。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: This concludes our role-play session. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました。とても勉強になりました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you. This was very insightful.)

topic.sub: 彼との束縛によるストレスと暴力的な関係
